name: ducci
description: The Ducci map (cyclic absolute differences) in the browser: the four-number game with a solver, nested-polygon and rule-102 views, and exhaustive censuses — every binary word up to n = 32 and every quadruple up to 4100 — checked against OEIS A135547, A111944, A038553, A065677 and A065678. TypeScript, no runtime deps.
